note: The lock-screen rules over every committed Foray, through the page's own build of it (player/parity/forays.js). Authored invariants — zero violations, true — so a publish that edits or adds Forays cannot turn them red, only one that breaks what a car display shows. A Foray deleted from data/ must drop its cases here.

covers: media-session::data/forays.json still has Forays to check this against
cases.note: The precondition of every committed-Foray case below: at least two Forays to run the rules over.

covers: media-session::a narration item is credited to the FORAY, never to a publisher and never to us (L-06/F15)
media-session::F15's own inputs: a narration line with no next item never says 4a in the CREDIT
cases.note: '4a is never the artist of anything audible' (L-06 / F15), over every playable item of this committed Foray — segment, narration or jingle — through mediaMetadata and narrationCredit. Authored: zero.

covers: media-session::every segment of every shipped Foray maps to a non-empty title and artist
media-session::the display CHANGES at a seam where the source changes — a frozen car display is the failure
media-session::the shipped shows really do come out as the publishers' names
cases.note: Every playable item has a title and a credit and an album naming the Foray; no join leaves the car display unchanged; every segment is credited to its show; narration and the jingle wear only the app's artwork. Authored: zero violations.

covers: media-session::mediaSessionView reports the FORAY's clock, not the segment's
cases.note: At the tape item past the midpoint, halfway through: the lock screen's duration is the Foray's total (not the segment's length) and its position is the Foray clock. Authored.
